newsitem.title: USA: Treadco says retread pricing under pressure.
newsitem.headline: Treadco says retread pricing under pressure.

text.p: Treadco Inc said Thursday its tire retread pricing continues to suffer from intense competition and falling new tire prices.

The company said, however, that it was encouraged by improved results despite the difficult competitive environment. Treadco reported today that its second quarter net loss narrowed to $0.01 per share from $0.10 a year ago.
"I am encouraged by the improvement made this quarter versus the first quarter and last year," said John R. Meyers, the company's president and chief executive in a statement.
"As the second quarter results indicate, our efforts to restore profitability are well underway and we are headed in the right direction," he said.
